species.sourceSummary: D99 labels, 365 right-hemisphere GIFTI surface names, and 3 volume-backed labels extracted nondestructively from the staged tgz archive.
catalogNotes: 365 rows reference right-hemisphere GIFTI surface files.
3 rows have no right-hemisphere GIFTI surface and reference D99_atlas_v2.0_right.nii.gz for volume extraction.

licenseCaveat: D99/AFNI states atlas datasets may not be modified or redistributed without prior consent. Treat this as prototype/internal unless permission is obtained.

meshNamingConvention.description: When using D99 right-hemisphere surfaces, converted mesh stems should match regions[].meshName, usually the GIFTI stem such as D99_v2.pu.k1. The 3 rows without right GIFTI surfaces keep meshName keys but require volume extraction from the D99 right atlas volume.

groupNormalization.description: Blank source CSV groups are normalized to frontend group Ungrouped. Source group text is preserved in sourceGroup.

duplicateLabelPolicy: Duplicate biological labels from source atlases are preserved. Use structureId or meshName, not label alone, as region identity.
